extracted.name: How to Cook Quinoa
extracted.description: Use this easy fool-proof method to make perfect light, fluffy quinoa every time!
instruction_lines: Combine the quinoa and water in a medium pot. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce the heat, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove from the heat and let it sit, covered for 10 more minutes.
